accueil.resume: Forgetting curve, spaced repetition (FSRS), active recall
accueil.intro: This course explains why the daily session works. Start with it, then choose how you want to study.
accueil.sources: Sources: Ebbinghaus's work (1885) on forgetting, research on the spacing effect and the testing effect, the open-source open-spaced-repetition project (FSRS). The values on the curve are recomputed with the simplified form given in the course sheet.

exercices.intro: Calculations with the course sheet's retention curve, then a written answer.
exercices.note: Values are recomputed with the simplified form of the curve (fixed slope).
